lessons.title: Checking In

items.example: J'ai une réservation.
items.exampleMeaning: I have a reservation.

items.example: Où est la clé de ma chambre ?
items.exampleMeaning: Where is the key to my room?

items.example: Il y a un lit dans ma chambre.
items.exampleMeaning: There is a bed in my room.

items.example: L'ascenseur est à gauche.
items.exampleMeaning: The elevator is on the left.

items.example: Je vais à l'accueil.
items.exampleMeaning: I am going to the reception.

items.example: Je souhaite avoir une chambre calme.
items.exampleMeaning: I wish to have a quiet room.

lessons.tip: Use 'il y a' to say 'there is' or 'there are' in French. Remember to match the verb with the number of items you speak about.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Hello, do you have a reservation?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I have a reservation.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What is your name?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: My name is Alex.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Voici la clé de votre chambre.
dialogue.meaning: Here is the key to your room.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Thank you very much!

scenario.partnerRole: The hotel staff member who checks in guests.
scenario.learnerRole: A guest checking into the hotel.
scenario.brief: Start by greeting each other. Ask if the guest has a reservation, then ask for their name and give them the key.
scenario.goal: You need to check in and receive your room key.

lessons.title: Reporting a Problem

items.example: Il y a un problème avec ma chambre.
items.exampleMeaning: There is a problem with my room.

items.example: Ma chambre est bruyante.
items.exampleMeaning: My room is noisy.

items.example: Je veux changer de chambre.
items.exampleMeaning: I want to change rooms.

items.example: Il faut réparer le chauffage.
items.exampleMeaning: The heating needs to be repaired.

items.example: Je vais demander de l'aide.
items.exampleMeaning: I will ask for help.

items.example: Il y a un problème avec la connexion Wi-Fi.
items.exampleMeaning: There is a problem with the Wi-Fi connection.

lessons.tip: When you report a problem, use 'Il y a' for 'There is' to explain the issue. Be polite when asking for help.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Hello, how can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Il y a un problème avec ma chambre.
dialogue.meaning: There is a problem with my room.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What is the problem?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: My room is noisy.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: D'accord, je vais changer votre chambre.
dialogue.meaning: Okay, I will change your room.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Thank you for your help.

scenario.partnerRole: The hotel staff member who helps guests with issues.
scenario.learnerRole: A guest reporting a problem with their room.
scenario.brief: Start by greeting and explaining you have a problem. Describe the issue and ask for a solution.
scenario.goal: You need to report a problem and ask to change rooms.

lessons.title: Making Polite Requests

items.example: Pourriez-vous m'aider, s'il vous plaît ?
items.exampleMeaning: Could you help me, please?

items.example: Pourriez-vous m'aider à trouver ma chambre?
items.exampleMeaning: Could you help me find my room?

items.example: Je voudrais avoir une chambre calme.
items.exampleMeaning: I would like to have a quiet room.

items.example: Merci de votre aide !
items.exampleMeaning: Thank you for your help!

items.example: Est-ce que vous avez un plan de la ville ?
items.exampleMeaning: Do you have a city map?

items.example: Certainement, je peux vous apporter un coussin supplémentaire.
items.exampleMeaning: Certainly, I can bring you an extra pillow.

lessons.tip: Use 'pourriez-vous' to make polite requests. It shows respect and is a good way to ask for something.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bonjour, que puis-je faire pour vous ?
dialogue.meaning: Hello, what can I do for you?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Could you help me, please?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bien sûr, quel est le problème ?
dialogue.meaning: Of course, what is the problem?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Je voudrais avoir une chambre calme.
dialogue.meaning: I would like to have a quiet room.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Est-ce que vous avez une réservation ?
dialogue.meaning: Do you have a reservation?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, thank you for your help!

scenario.partnerRole: The hotel staff member who assists guests.
scenario.learnerRole: A guest making polite requests at the hotel.
scenario.brief: Start by explaining you need assistance. Make a polite request for help or information.
scenario.goal: You need to make a polite request and receive assistance.

lessons.title: Finding Amenities

items.example: Où se trouve la piscine ?
items.exampleMeaning: Where is the swimming pool?

items.example: Le petit déjeuner est servi à 8 heures.
items.exampleMeaning: Breakfast is served at 8 o'clock.

items.example: Où est le mot de passe du Wi-Fi ?
items.exampleMeaning: Where is the Wi-Fi password?

items.example: Le restaurant est au premier étage.
items.exampleMeaning: The restaurant is on the first floor.

items.example: Où sont les toilettes ?
items.exampleMeaning: Where are the restrooms?

items.example: Vous avez besoin de la clé pour entrer.
items.exampleMeaning: You need the key to enter.

lessons.tip: To ask for directions or locations, use 'où se trouve' for 'where is'. It's a helpful phrase in any situation.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Hello, how can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Where is the restaurant?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Le restaurant est au premier étage.
dialogue.meaning: The restaurant is on the first floor.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: And the restrooms?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: The restrooms are on the right.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Merci, avez-vous besoin de la clé ?
dialogue.meaning: Thank you, do you need the key?

scenario.partnerRole: The hotel staff member who provides information.
scenario.learnerRole: A guest looking for hotel amenities.
scenario.brief: Start by asking for help. Inquire about the location of different amenities in the hotel.
scenario.goal: You need to find out where the amenities are located.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Hello, how can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Where is the swimming pool?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: The swimming pool is in the basement.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Je voudrais un café, s'il vous plaît.
dialogue.meaning: I would like a coffee, please.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Okay, I will bring it to you.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Il y a un problème avec ma chambre.
dialogue.meaning: There is a problem with my room.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What is the problem?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: My room is noisy.

scenario.partnerRole: The hotel staff member who assists guests.
scenario.learnerRole: A guest with various inquiries and issues.
scenario.brief: You will ask about your reservation, report a problem, and inquire about amenities.
scenario.goal: You need to successfully navigate the hotel experience.
